name: dsh-unlag
description: A press applies plugin edits right away and brings a laggy interface back; automatic reloading stays off unless you turn it on, so the press is the only trigger, and nothing restarts.

scripts.test: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
